direction: Simple Ava/Max-compatible repaired sprites for all five chapters
sourceLicense: References are repository Kenney CC0-derived sprites; original license retained in assets/gear/LICENSE-Kenney-CC0.txt. Generated repairs are recorded separately, not represented as original Kenney artwork.
normalization: 512x512 WebP; true alpha verified; disconnected alpha specks removed; uniform safe margin and bottom-centre anchor; aspect ratio preserved.

assets.prompt:
This is a repair of the attached game sprite, not a change of visual style. Preserve its identity and original flat vector / simple softly shaded cartoon appearance: large expressive eyes, broad simple colour shapes, tiny clean highlights, smooth edges, no painted texture, no realism, no fur or scales, no outlines added. Fix the mangled assembly: draw exactly two anatomically connected arms with complete rounded hands, exactly two connected short legs and complete feet. Keep limbs distinct and avoid detached circles at the joints. The entire character must fit comfortably inside a square canvas with at least 12 percent genuinely transparent margin on every edge. Use the extra canvas space to finish the hands and feet that were cut off by the original image edges. Full body, front view, standing neutral pose, bottom-centre ground anchor. No floor, no scenery, no text, no frame, no shadow baked into the background. Genuinely transparent background. The output must look at home beside the existing simple Ava and Max game characters.
Maintain the original coral-red rounded egg-shaped fire monster, its two brown eyes with pale mint eyelids, small worried mouth and two white fangs. Arms can be naturally bent beside the torso rather than wildly twisted. Hands have three simple round fingers. No horns, no ears, no wings, no tail.
assets.review: Inspected as a family and in the five-chapter desktop browser playthrough
